subject: Renewal + Right-size: Soteria Labs Dedicated GPU Plan
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@soterialabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@soterialabs.com
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Usage spike & renewal conversation — need sizing advice

Hi Stephanie,

Quick background: we’re coming up on our annual renewal (9/30) and the last two months we’ve seen a sustained spike in inference utilization — 40% higher than our Q2 projections. We’ve been on a 24xV100 equivalent reserved tranche (8 GPUs) with Redwood Dedicated. The team is seeing queueing in peak windows that’s starting to affect SLAs for our clinical summarization feature.

Could we set up a short session to review utilization and options for resizing or adding a tranche for the next 12 months? I attached a CSV extract of our token-level utilization and a daily peak report (util_report_Q3.csv). Procurement is looped in for budget checks.

High level asks:
- Right-sizing recommendation (do we add GPUs or change batching/quantization?)
- Estimated cost delta if we add 4 GPUs for 3 months as a buffer while usage normalizes
- Timeline for provisioning if we go ahead

Thanks — Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Platform | Soteria Labs

Attachment: util_report_Q3.csv (CSV excerpt, 52KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@soterialabs.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike & renewal conversation — need sizing advice

Hi Lena — thanks for the data, and for looping procurement. We can definitely help. I took a quick pass on the CSV and sketched an options table (attached as dedicated_proposal_v2.pdf) but want to align on a couple of constraints first:

1) Target SLA window for the clinical summarization peak (p99 latency target?)
2) Will you accept a temporary tranche (3 months) that we convert to permanent commit if utilization sustains?
3) Any compliance/networking changes for private Dedicated capacity?

Initial recommendations (high level):
- Short term: add 4x A100s equivalents as a 3-month buffer + apply tighter KV-prefix caching on repeat patient summaries. This reduces queueing quickly.
- Medium term: run a brief quality/regression eval on quantized 4-bit variants for your model family; if acceptable, we can recommend a permanent resize of the commit down to 10 GPUs with quantization for cost parity.

I’ve looped Dev to confirm provisioning ETA and Marissa for commercial terms (prorated credits and contract addendum). Can we do a 30-minute sync tomorrow at 1pm PT?

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0148

Attachment: dedicated_proposal_v2.pdf (proposal summary, 120KB)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@soterialabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Usage spike & renewal conversation — need sizing advice

On Wed, Aug 13, 2025 at 11:02 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> I’ve looped Dev to confirm provisioning ETA and Marissa for commercial terms (prorated credits and contract addendum). Can we do a 30-minute sync tomorrow at 1pm PT?

Thanks, Stephanie — short answers: provisioning for +4 A100-equivalent instances (reserved short tranche) can be turned on in 48 hours for hosted customers; for Dedicated we need a 5-business-day lead time to allocate and validate network/VPC routing. If Soteria can accept a 48-hour hosted burst into your Dedicated fleet (we can NAT and secure traffic) we can mitigate the immediate queueing within 2 days while we provision the Dedicated tranche.

Technical notes:
- We recommend enabling continuous batching with a target max-latency of 300ms for the non-clinical paths and preserving p99 < 1.2s for the clinical summarizer.
- KV prefix caching should reduce repeated-token work by ~18–25% in the observed traces.
- If you want persistent disk-backed KV for large prompt states, add 1 extra disk-attached node (recommended only if median sequence length > 2k).

I’ll be on the sync and bring the infra runbook for provisioning and the validation checklist.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@soterialabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@soterialabs.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike & renewal conversation — need sizing advice

Thanks both — the hosted burst sounds like a good short-term fix while procurement clears budget for a 3-month trial tranche. Procurement is ok with the 5-business-day Dedicated provisioning if we sign an addendum that specifies credits if utilization falls below X%. Can Marissa and Stephanie own the commercial addendum?

Procurement note: please send an estimated cost delta for +4 GPUs for 3 months (broken out by list vs committed pricing), and the language we can put into the SOW about credits/true-up. I’ve copied procurement.

Lena

On Aug 13, 2025, at 2:05 PM, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (quoted infra notes)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 03 Sep 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike & renewal conversation — need sizing advice

Hi Lena and Soteria procurement team —

Per the ask, attached is the cost delta and proposed contract language for a 3-month +4 GPU trial tranche. Summary:
- List pricing delta (3 months): $48,000
- Committed tranche pricing (prorated, with 3-month trial addendum): $33,600
- Proposed credit clause: if actual average utilization across the trial period is below 50% of the provisioned capacity for more than 30 consecutive days, Redwood will issue a prorated credit equal to 50% of the unused tranche cost.

Next steps:
1) Soteria to confirm acceptance of the credit clause and pricing — procurement indicated verbal OK pending written SOW.
2) We’ll issue an addendum and a DocuSign package; provisioning ETA (if signed) is 5 business days for Dedicated tranche.
3) We’ll enable hosted burst within 48 hours as an interim mitigation (requires Soteria confirmation to flip traffic).

If you’re happy I’ll send the DocuSign link and include the PO fields (we can accept a signed PO or DocuSign).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199

Attachment: soteria_po_signed.pdf (placeholder — final when PO received)
